div.div: Solid line = request/data flow. Dashed purple = the flight planning drawer's AI-narrative comparison (webapp calls both agents' HTTP wrappers, not MCP). Dashed grey = a cross-layer handoff (promoted model) or a parallel build not in the request path (crewai-agent, docker-api). Dashed border = runs in-process rather than as its own container.
